run_export_inlier_pairs: run the script to export inlier image pairs from a COLMAP database to a text file
run_pair_id_to_image_ids: run the pair_id_to_image_ids function to decode a COLMAP pair ID into two image IDs
run_parse_args: run the parse_args function to parse command-line arguments for database path, match list path, and minimum matches
run_main: run the main function to query a COLMAP SQLite database and write filtered inlier pairs to an output file
refactor_pair_id_to_image_ids: refactor the pair_id_to_image_ids function to use integer division instead of float division
